name: Glyph Workspaces
author: Jean Alvarado
description: Workspace indicators with a Pac-Man that travels to the focused workspace eating the pellets on the way, plus dots, numbers, and custom glyph styles.

barWidget.description: A drop-in replacement for the built-in workspace indicators, with a Pac-Man that walks between workspaces.

options.label: 󰮯  Pac-Man
options.description: Pac-Man travels to the focused workspace, eating the pellets on the way

options.label: 󰝥  Dots
options.description: A filled dot per occupied workspace, a small one per empty workspace

options.label:   Numbers
options.description: Workspace numbers, like the built-in widget

options.label:   Custom glyphs
options.description: Your own two characters, one for occupied workspaces and one for empty

schema.label: Workspaces
schema.description: How many workspaces to always show. Live workspaces above this still appear, up to 10.

schema.label: Occupied glyph
schema.description: Used when Style is Custom glyphs. Any character: a pasted Nerd Font glyph or an emoji.

schema.label: Empty glyph
schema.description: Used when Style is Custom glyphs, for workspaces with no windows.

schema.label: Focused glyph
schema.description: Replaces the marker on the workspace you're on, in every style except Pac-Man. Empty leaves each style's own focused marker. Set it to 󱓻 to match the built-in widget.

schema.label: Color
schema.description: Empty follows the active theme. Use "accent", "urgent", "muted", or a #rrggbb hex value.

schema.label: Active color
schema.description: Colour of Pac-Man and of the focused marker. Empty matches Color above.

schema.label: Focus indicator
schema.description: A mark on the focused slot, so focus survives a theme whose accent matches its foreground. Auto draws an underline for every style except Pac-Man, who marks it himself.

schema.label: Urgent workspaces
schema.description: What a workspace does when a window on it asks for attention.

schema.label: Empty opacity
schema.description: Opacity of workspaces with no windows, as a percentage.

schema.label: Marker size
schema.description: Pixel size of the markers. Pac-Man scales with it. 0 follows the bar.

schema.label: Slot width
schema.description: Width of one workspace slot, which sets how far apart the markers sit. 0 picks a spacing that suits the style.

schema.label: Speed
schema.description: Travel and chomp speed, as a percentage. Higher is faster.

schema.label: Eat pellets
schema.description: Pellets vanish as Pac-Man passes them, and come back a moment after he arrives.

schema.label: Scroll to switch
schema.description: Scrolling over the widget moves to the previous or next workspace.
